features.reason: PostgreSQL wire transport and psql client commands are not embedded SQL.
ast_match: psql client commands and transport negotiation (not SQL AST)

features.reason: Database instances and filesystem placement are host-owned.
The embedded principal is not a PostgreSQL privilege enforcement subsystem.
ast_match: AlterTableCmd owner or row security subcommands
object kind ROLE, POLICY, DEFACL, PARAMETER_ACL

features.reason: External extensions and native or external language handlers are not loaded.
ast_match: object kind EXTENSION, LANGUAGE, TRANSFORM, TSPARSER, TSTEMPLATE
AlterTypeStmt native I/O, typmod, analyze, or subscript handler options

features.reason: Only local database objects participate in execution.
ast_match: object kind FDW, FOREIGN_SERVER, FOREIGN_TABLE, USER_MAPPING

features.reason: The embedded backend has no PostgreSQL replication or archive SQL interface.
ast_match: object kind PUBLICATION, PUBLICATION_NAMESPACE, PUBLICATION_REL, SUBSCRIPTION

features.reason: Distributed prepared transactions and exported snapshots are not implemented.
Read-write transactions accept only SERIALIZABLE; read-only transactions use fixed snapshots.
ast_match: resolved isolation setting = read committed, read uncommitted, repeatable read

features.reason: PostgreSQL asynchronous notification channels are not provided.
SQL cannot access server files, programs, or PostgreSQL large objects.
XML types and operations are outside the fixed SQL profile.
Only UTF8 and deterministic C/POSIX/default collations are available.
PostgreSQL physical storage and transaction identities are not NeoSepia objects.
ast_match: AlterTableCmd storage, compression, access method, logged/unlogged or column options; non-view AlterTableStmt relation options
resolved write target is system catalog

features.reason: Only logical ordered B-tree index semantics are available.
ast_match: object kind ACCESS_METHOD, OPCLASS, OPFAMILY, AMOP, AMPROC
resolved non-B-tree opclass or opclass parameters

features.reason: Temporal constraints and non-equality or non-B-tree exclusion constraints are unavailable.
ast_match: Constraint EXCLUSION with non-B-tree access method
resolved exclusion operator without B-tree equality strategy

features.reason: User rewrite rules and DDL event triggers are unavailable.
PostgreSQL heap and cluster maintenance is not embedded backend maintenance.
PostgreSQL server processes, physical statistics, and server-only settings are unavailable.
Replacing an existing aggregate with CREATE OR REPLACE AGGREGATE is not implemented; only the CREATE AGGREGATE form is admitted.
Session-local sequence state cannot be discarded, so DISCARD SEQUENCES and the sequence reset of DISCARD ALL are unavailable.
A write target whose descriptor requires constraint, index, trigger, or partition expansion the embedded writer does not implement.
ast_match: resolved INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE target requiring unsupported write-descriptor expansion or constraints

features.reason: EXTRACT, date_part, and date_trunc field units are limited to the units the embedded temporal kernels implement for the resolved type.
ast_match: resolved EXTRACT, date_part, or date_trunc field unit unsupported for the target date, time, timestamp, or interval type

features.reason: Character-set conversion is limited to the encodings the embedded conversion kernels implement (UTF8, LATIN1, and WIN1252).
ast_match: resolved convert_to, convert_from, or length(bytea, name) encoding outside the builtin conversion set

features.reason: All PostgreSQL 18.4 SQL outside the fixed exclusions is required, including missing implementations.
psql backslash commands are test-client input, not executable SQL or compatibility passes.
